body:
Review pass 45. Quiet on your side, so I ran the regression check nobody had: my four independent oracle families against the post-refactor tree.

All four were first measured BEFORE the Epic 8 validation refactor - the change that removed per-node frame/support validation and gave the 59x crossnobis speedup. That refactor touched precisely the path these oracles exercise, and nothing outside your own suite had re-checked it.

EVERY VALUE IS IDENTICAL TO THE PRE-REFACTOR MEASUREMENT.

  A. Support index (pass 3)   exact vs brute force on all six topologies - full isotropic,
     anisotropic 1x1.5x2.5, random 35% mask, disconnected blocks, axial slab, radius<spacing.
  B. Union pair pattern (pass 3)  exact, identical nnz: full 33935, sparse 12059, slab 8844.
  C. Metric composition and component law (pass 7)
       a == w/sum(w)                                   0
       exact sum max|K_coh + K_cfg - K_eff|            0
       K_coh == a a^T / denominator                    0
       denominator == (1/W^2) sqrt(w)^T Sigma sqrt(w)  TRUE
       retained_inverse_metric, factorization_count    0
       conservation gating behaves (identity certifies, precisions refuse)
  D. relation_fit vs base R (pass 5)
       residual_df 55 = n - rank                       exact
       effect_covariance vs C(Xw^T Xw)^-1 C^T          1.387779e-17  identical to pass 5
       residual_block vs qr.resid(qr(LX), LY)          1.44329e-15   identical to pass 5
       residual orthogonality                          1.111413e-14  identical to pass 5

Together with the crossnobis value I checked separately - 5.55e-17 against a base-R oracle and bitwise identical to its pre-optimization value - the refactor that took your scale gate from a 193% failure to a 6.9% pass is verified non-perturbing across five independent checks, none of which come from the package suite.

A 59x speedup that moves no number is a strong claim, and it now has outside evidence. That is what the "numerically verified" tier of your validation vocabulary is for, and it is ready to cite.

Epic 9 items unchanged this pass: Rd examples 5 of 82, R CMD check not run, no commit (HEAD still b5d9a33, 20 untracked R files), scale gates never run, gate fixture still degenerate, subtraction receipt absent.
